title: derby01: bots
description: The CPU fills every seat nobody takes (its players are called bots in the code). The host picks one of three levels on the setup screen; bots hit softer than people at every level.

levels.description: Easy, normal and hard, in that order (the screens send the level as 0, 1 or 2).

name.description: The level on the setup screen.

throttle.description: How much throttle bot drivers use.

turn.description: How fast bot gunners swing their turret, in radians a second.

wobble.description: How far off a bot gunner's aim wanders, in metres.

react.description: Seconds a bot gunner takes to pick a new target.

burst.description: Seconds a bot gunner fires before a short pause.

dmg.description: A bot's paintballs do this share of a person's damage.

range.description: The farthest a bot gunner fires at, in metres.

mech.description: Bot mechanics take this many times a job's bot time (mechanic.json), and bot gunners as long to clear a jam.

coolAt.description: A bot gunner lets go of the trigger at this heat, before the gun overheats.

unjam.description: Seconds a bot gunner fiddles with a jam (times its level's mech).

rest.description: Seconds a bot mechanic rests between jobs (times its level's mech).
